closed_design_questions: Current V5 runtime is RNA-to-RNA and cannot be silently reinterpreted as a rich multimodal teacher.
Privileged teacher factors require explicit RNA-recoverability classification before universal student supervision.
Recoverability should be qualified at stable-subspace level when axes rotate.
GENCODE annotation defines the base promoter/TSS candidate denominator; activity resources annotate rather than censor it.
Common support and trim fraction must be characterized before E2 matching operator freeze.
SCARlink versus SCENT on the same NIH-CARD cells is estimator robustness, not evidence-family independence.
Adjusted cross-resource association is incremental support under observed adjustment, not proof of independence.
Held-out evidence-family validation is preferred over reconstruction of evidence used in construction.
Access and license/terms status are separate provenance fields.
NOT_MEASURED remains distinct from measured negative evidence.
